title: Frog dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- left foot -->
  <ellipse cx="28" cy="82" rx="10" ry="5" fill="#4CAF50"/>
  <ellipse cx="28" cy="82" rx="7" ry="3.5" fill="#66BB6A"/>
  <!-- right foot -->
  <ellipse cx="72" cy="82" rx="10" ry="5" fill="#4CAF50"/>
  <ellipse cx="72" cy="82" rx="7" ry="3.5" fill="#66BB6A"/>
  <!-- left leg -->
  <rect x="30" y="66" width="8" height="16" rx="4" fill="#66BB6A"/>
  <!-- right leg -->
  <rect x="62" y="66" width="8" height="16" rx="4" fill="#66BB6A"/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="58" rx="22" ry="18" fill="#4CAF50"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="58" rx="18" ry="14" fill="#66BB6A"/>
  <!-- left arm raised -->
  <path d="M30 50 Q18 38 14 30" stroke="#4CAF50" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <circle cx="14" cy="30" r="5" fill="#66BB6A"/>
  <!-- right arm raised -->
  <path d="M70 50 Q82 38 86 30" stroke="#4CAF50" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <circle cx="86" cy="30" r="5" fill="#66BB6A"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="32" rx="20" ry="16" fill="#4CAF50"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="32" rx="17" ry="13" fill="#66BB6A"/>
  <!-- left eye -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="26" r="7" fill="#4CAF50"/>
  <circle cx="40" cy="26" r="5" fill="#E8F5E9"/>
  <circle cx="40" cy="26" r="3" fill="#1B5E20"/>
  <circle cx="41.5" cy="24.5" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- right eye -->
  <circle cx="60" cy="26" r="7" fill="#4CAF50"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="26" r="5" fill="#E8F5E9"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="26" r="3" fill="#1B5E20"/>
  <circle cx="61.5" cy="24.5" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M40 38 Q50 46 60 38" stroke="#1B5E20" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="60" rx="12" ry="8" fill="#A5D6A7"/>
  <!-- dance motion lines -->
  <path d="M8 20 Q5 14 10 10" stroke="#FFEB3B" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M92 20 Q95 14 90 10" stroke="#FFEB3B" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M50 4 Q54 8 50 12" stroke="#FFEB3B" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <!-- music notes -->
  <circle cx="12" cy="14" r="2.5" fill="#FFD54F"/>
  <rect x="13.5" y="6" width="1.5" height="8" fill="#FFD54F"/>
  <path d="M13.5 6 Q17 5 17 9" stroke="#FFD54F" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
  <circle cx="88" cy="14" r="2.5" fill="#FFD54F"/>
  <rect x="89.5" y="6" width="1.5" height="8" fill="#FFD54F"/>
  <path d="M89.5 6 Q93 5 93 9" stroke="#FFD54F" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
</svg>
